releaseTitle: Coffeely v2.4.4 — Offline Mode & Smart Error Alerts
releaseNotes: 📡 Smart Offline Mode: Top banner notification when network is lost
⚡ Instant Reconnect: Smooth auto-recovery when connection returns
🔒 Accurate Auth Feedback: Clear error messages for wrong passwords, unverified accounts, and network issues
🚀 Session Preservation: Stay logged in even when opening app offline
